## Personality

Jerry is a hired boy known for his cheerful disposition. His lively demeanor is a source of resentment for [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), who views it as a personal insult.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XIV. Anne’s Confession P54](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0054)_

## History

Jerry served as the driver who took [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to the Sunday school picnic after [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) discovered her missing brooch and realized Anne's innocence. He drove her to the event, allowing [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to attend and ultimately have a wonderful day.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XIV. Anne’s Confession P56](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0056), [v1 CHAPTER XIV. Anne’s Confession P60](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0060), [v1 CHAPTER XIV. Anne’s Confession P62](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0062), [v1 CHAPTER XIV. Anne’s Confession P68](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0068)_
